text:
Marcus L.: Heads up — AcmeCo says invoice INV-2025-04-01 doesn't include their PO 78-9002. They already paid by card last week (TXN-9a7f). Their AP won't accept expense without PO on the invoice. Can we do a retroactive fix or do credit+reissue? cc @Priya K., @billing-bot

Priya K.: If payment is settled our normal flow is credit + reissue with PO populated. Need finance approval (backdated docs) and the payment txn id + original invoice id.

Marcus L.: Details: Invoice INV-2025-04-01, paid 2025-04-05, amount $12,450, TXN-9a7f. Customer insists the PO must appear on official invoice.

Alex G.: We can't edit a finalized invoice in the ledger (audit/tax rules). Standard process: 1) issue full credit note for INV-2025-04-01, 2) create new invoice with PO 78-9002 (INV-2025-04-01-R1), 3) apply payment to the new invoice or do manual allocation, 4) send both docs with explanation. Typically 1 business day after finance signs off.

Samir R.: I need to confirm VAT/tax implications. If the credit and new invoice are posted in the same tax period it's straightforward. If not, we'll need a small journal entry. I'll take the tax check.

Marcus L.: What wording should I give the customer so they know what to expect? Keep it simple.

Priya K.: Tell them: "We will issue a credit for the original invoice and send a corrected invoice that includes your PO. The credit and new invoice will net to the same amount; you'll receive both documents for your records. This typically completes within 1 business day after finance approval." Then: next steps for our side:
1) Confirm payment TXN-9a7f and invoice INV-2025-04-01 (Marcus)
2) Finance approval for credit/reissue (Priya)
3) Accounting tax check (Samir)
4) Billing to create CN-2025-04-01 and INV-2025-04-01-R1 and apply payment (Alex)

Priya K.: Quick lookup commands for the team:```# lookup
GET /invoices/INV-2025-04-01
GET /payments/TXN-9a7f
POST /credits { "invoice": "INV-2025-04-01", "reason": "PO missing" }
```

billing-bot: Created ticket FIN-4821 for credit/reissue request and assigned to billing queue.

Marcus L.: Thanks all — I'll confirm with the customer that they accept credit+reissue and will post the payment screenshot. Looping in @Samir R. for VAT check. Priya, please ping finance for approval.

Priya K.: On it, will update here when finance signs off.
